title: New York City Transit Authority Graphics Standards Manual

description.main: A 2014 full-size reissue of the 1970 NYCTA Graphics Standards Manual by Massimo Vignelli and Bob Noorda of Unimark.
description.extended:
A reissue of the 1970 New York City Transit Authority Graphics Standards Manual, the guidelines for the city's subway signs designed by Massimo Vignelli and Bob Noorda of Unimark, reproduced from scans of the original.

Standards Manual, LLC first published the book in 2014 as a full-size reissue, and a smaller compact edition followed in 2015. The scans come from the private collection of Massimo and Lella Vignelli, supplied by their son Luca Vignelli. The original sheets measured 13 by 13 inches, and the compact edition reduces them by 26 percent to 10 by 10. The typeface NYCTA Standard Medium was drawn by Nick Sherman in 2014 from scans of the manual, keeping the original spacing and kerning.

In his essay “Stand Clear,” Christopher Bonanos describes the system the manual set in place: white lettering on black, line discs in ten official colors, and red and yellow backgrounds for exits and warnings, mostly set in Helvetica. Vignelli is credited here with Noorda and Unimark.

notes: EDITION UNRESOLVED: spine alone cannot separate the full-size 2014 reissue (ISBN 9780692299241, OpenLibrary 364 pp, Jan 2014) from the compact 2015 edition (ISBN 9780692496954, 356 pp, 10 x 10 in, 26% reduction of the 13 x 13 in original; OpenLibrary 2015). Per brief, the full-size reissue is described; if the shelf copy measures about 10 x 10 in it is the compact one and the ISBN, year, pages and cover must change (compact ISBN 9780692496954, year 2015). Publisher site now sells only the compact edition, so full-size specs (dimensions, pages) are not stated by any fetched source; dimensions left null. Cover is the OpenLibrary image for the 2014 ISBN (460x459, tight crop; the AbeBooks image for that ISBN is a skewed photo on a wooden table and was rejected). Corporate/editor-led credit: no existing rows to copy; authors are the named designers, issuing body Standards Manual in notes. Jesse Reed and Hamish Smyth appear as creators in OpenLibrary/AbeBooks, role label is a guess ('Reissue').
